hypotheses.title: Smoothed Dynamic Customer Network Reversal with 5-Day Weekly Delta Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Refines Candidate 2 (1.22 Sharpe, 0.70 Sub-universe) by replacing raw 3-day close delta with a 5-day linearly decayed delta (ts_decay_linear(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, 5)). Smoothing the secondary price reversal branch cuts turnover from 31% to ~18%, preserving the strong 0.70 sub-universe Sharpe while elevating full-universe Sharpe past 1.25 and Fitness past 1.00.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 5-day smoothed delta fails to lower turnover or degrades sub-universe Sharpe below 0.53.
